summary: An AI Incident Database intake reference associated with an alleged 3M expert-report event was flagged during VIGIL intake because its supporting source mapping appeared inconsistent with the described event. The alleged 3M event is therefore withheld from substantive VIGIL failure-mode evidence pending source verification.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: VIGIL uses incident registries as discovery sources but must not inherit possible source-mapping errors. Recording the anomaly protects evidence-chain integrity and makes non-ingestion an explicit governed decision rather than silent omission.
